summary: 3 E Network Technology Group, a BVI-incorporated NASDAQ foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the September 22, 2026 resignation of independent director and Audit Committee chair Hao Liu from the board and all committees, effective that date. The remaining board immediately appointed Chunhui Zhu, 50, as independent director, Audit Committee chair, and member of the Compensation and Nominating/Corporate Governance Committees, with a three-year term through September 21, 2029 and US$30,000 annual compensation paid quarterly. No board recommendation, advisor, or shareholder vote was disclosed. The abrupt audit-chair vacancy warrants monitoring for delayed filings, internal-control issues, or further board turnover.
